name: Osskai Cardamom-Dark Praline Bar
description: A 40g bar of genuine single-origin cocoa blended with cardamom-infused synth-praline, wrapped in embossed foil and a paper sleeve with provenance documentation. One of the few real-cocoa products available below Tier 5.
flavor_profile: Deep, complex real chocolate bitterness underpinned by aromatic cardamom warmth and a buttery praline sweetness — lingering, full-bodied finish
cultural_context: Osskai Reserve Bars are the aspirational ceiling of the Tier 3 candy market — purchased for significant personal milestones, given as serious gifts, or split between two people as a romantic gesture. The provenance documentation (listing the cocoa's origin farm, harvest year, and transport chain) has become a minor collector's item. Tier 4 consumers sometimes buy them casually, which Tier 3 consumers find quietly offensive.
story_hooks: A counterfeit Osskai bar — synth-cocoa in genuine Osskai packaging with forged provenance docs — has entered the Tier 3 market; someone with access to Halvex's supply chain is behind it, and the company wants it resolved quietly.
The single cocoa origin farm listed on recent Osskai provenance documents is a settlement that officially doesn't exist on GLMZ's registered agricultural maps — what's actually growing there?

A Tier 3 couple has been saving for three months to buy a single Osskai bar for an anniversary; a party member with Tier 4 resources discovers this and must decide whether 'helping' would be generous or condescending.
